metadata_marker_applies_to: All nine existing P06 GET responses; fields below only appear on cards

description.reason: SOURCE_NOT_DEFINED; no canonical SKU description column or owner source verified

null_reasons.NOT_ASSIGNED: The exact SKU foreign key is null
null_reasons.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: The SKU foreign key is present but its LEFT JOIN master row is absent; no alternate master lookup
null_reasons.LABEL_UNAVAILABLE: Referenced master exists but its label is null, blank or not a string
null_reasons.SOURCE_NOT_DEFINED: Description deliberately null; never copy sku_name, Web HTML, specification array or another field

inactive_master_policy: Keep the existing referenced label and disclose CURRENT_INACTIVE_MASTER. No eligibility grant, FK repair or master activation. SKU status filter remains independent.
unknown_master_status_policy: Keep a valid label with CURRENT_MASTER_STATUS_UNKNOWN, never assume ACTIVE
shape_diff_from_proposal: Same three requested field names and locations; additionally metadata_status provides per-card reasons and meta.card_metadata_revision identifies the additive revision
identity: Exact SKU UUID. ITEM follows item_instances.sku_id. Keyword search is not identity and does not merge case-sensitive SKU variants.
queries: No changes to supported filters, mandatory warehouse_id, paging maximum 100, tab_totals, sort or count_unit. Two LEFT JOINs only in the row projection after original count queries. Master primary keys prevent fan-out; no per-row master queries.

cache_and_version.result_cache: No internal P06 result cache; each request reads current master rows inside its database snapshot
cache_and_version.read_after_change: Next GET observes committed FK/label changes; no global flush required
cache_and_version.card_version: Existing SKU or ITEM version, NOT a label content hash. Master-only label change need not increment it.
cache_and_version.stock_version: Existing quantity/balance fingerprint, unaffected by master label changes
cache_and_version.etag: No new ETag protocol or conditional GET shortcut; do not cache card metadata by SKU version alone
cache_and_version.snapshot: Single response only; no cross-request snapshot guarantee

authorization: Unchanged auth:api/stable ACTIVE actor/confirmed READY session warehouse, sku.view, item_instance.view for ITEM/identity filters, inventory.view for stock, inventory.trace and/or warranty source rights for timeline. Metadata does not disclose actor or customer PII.
get_safety: No body, no writes, no seed, no cache flush, no flag or grant change

gaps_preserved.timeline_date_type_filter: UNSUPPORTED; rejected rather than silently ignored
